rules.citation: General Law - Part II, Title I, Chapter 186, Section 15B
rules.effective_date_basis: as amended by 2025, 9, Secs. 54 and 55 effective August 1, 2025
rules.title: Massachusetts residential security deposit and move-in payment limits
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a landlord or the landlord’s agent may not require more than first month’s rent, last month’s rent, a security deposit equal to one month’s rent, and key/lock costs. A security deposit must be receipted, supported by a statement of condition, kept in a separate interest-bearing Massachusetts bank account, and returned with allowable deductions within 30 days after the tenancy ends.
rules.key_value: Security deposit equal to first month’s rent; 5% or actual bank interest; return within 30 days; treble damages for specified violations

coverage.other_unresolvable: Does not apply to any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of 100 days or less in duration if for a vacation or recreational purpose.
coverage.summary: Applies to residential real property tenancies in Massachusetts, except short vacation or recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

rules.exemptions: The section does not apply to any lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of 100 days or less in duration when the lease or rental is for a vacation or recreational purpose.
rules.penalty: A landlord who fails to comply with specified security-deposit duties forfeits the right to retain any portion of the deposit; for failures covered by subsection (7), the tenant is awarded three times the deposit or balance owed, 5% interest from when payment became due, court costs, and reasonable attorney’s fees. Failure to pay required interest within 30 days after termination can result in treble damages for the unpaid interest plus costs and reasonable attorney’s fees.
